thread:
mira: Heads up — after last night's KMS rekey I'm seeing a bunch of reports of SAML logout redirect loops. Anyone else? :eyes:

sam: Seen a few. Users click logout -> redirect to IdP -> immediate redirect back to app and session still valid. Happening across multiple orgs.

jon: I pulled app logs — decrypt errors when trying to read the session cookie during logout: `KMS Decrypt failed: InvalidKeyVersion (kid mismatch)` for several session rewrap attempts.

mira: Can you paste the exact log lines?

jon: ```
2026-03-21T03:07:12Z service-auth warn session_rewrap failed user=acct-123 err="KMS Decrypt failed: InvalidKeyVersion: keyAlias:projects/redwood/keys/primary v=2"
2026-03-21T03:07:12Z service-auth debug logout flow aborted user=acct-123 reason="cookie decrypt"
```

mira: That would explain it — we rotated primary KMS key last night and disabled the old alias for a while. If the app expects to decrypt and read NameID from cookie to build a SAML LogoutRequest, decrypt failure aborts logout and redirects back.

sam: Confirmed. The logout handler tries to parse cookie payload to find NameID/SessionIndex and if decrypt fails we currently return user to app with a redirect (old behavior).

mira: I thought logout could be stateless and just redirect to IdP logout endpoint without reading cookie?

jon: Our implementation reads the NameID to craft the proper SingleLogoutRequest (SLO). If we can't decrypt, we bail early for safety. Bad tradeoff in this case.

sam: Short-term options:
- re-enable old key alias in KMS so decrypts succeed
- run a backend job to iterate sessions, decrypt with old key and rewrap with new key (requires old key material active)
- deploy a quick change to logout handler to fallback to a generic Redirect to IdP logout endpoint when decrypt fails (risk: might not match NameID semantics)

mira: Re-enabling old key alias sounds fastest. Any blockers?

jon: Only policy concern — we toggled allow-list for the old key as part of rotation. If we enable again it should work. We'll need to monitor audit logs.

mira: Also checking SCIM — any chance SCIM deprovisioning caused this? A few users reported deprovision then loop.

sam: SCIM logs show a handful of deprovision events at ~03:04 UTC but their sessions remained in session store. Deprovision won't change cookie decrypt behavior. Not root cause.

mira: Good call. Also double-check NameID format change we made last month (transient -> persistent) — logout may fail if NameID in cookie doesn't match IdP expectation. Add to checklist.

jon: Agreed. Immediate runbook I'm going to follow:```
1) Re-enable old-key alias in KMS for 24h (sam)
2) Increase auth debug logs to capture user id and cookie-subid (mira)
3) Run session_rewrap job: decrypt with old key -> re-encrypt with new key, commit (jon)
4) Once rewrap completes and monitoring shows no regressions, rotate alias back and retire old key per policy (engineering)
5) Postmortem and update KMS rotation checklist to include session rewrap + logout smoke tests
```

mira: @sam can you re-enable the old alias and DM when done? I'll open a Jira and run the rewrap job in staging first.

sam: re-enabled old-key alias, adding temporary allow-list entry now. Will post audit event.

deploy-bot: rotation-service: alias-old-key re-enabled by sam at 1823456795

mira: Jira SEC-1234 created and labeled sso/kms/logout-loop. @jon please kick off the rewrap on a small batch (staging-like orgs) before wide run.

jon: Starting rewrap on batch-1 now. Command: `./tools/session-rewrap --batch batch-1 --dry-run=false`
jon: ```
[03:10:02] batch-1: 0/200 rewrapped
[03:10:12] batch-1: 57/200 rewrapped (decrypt OK -> rewrapped)
[03:11:00] batch-1: 200/200 done
```

sam: Monitoring user reports, error rate on logout dropped to near zero.

mira: Good. We'll keep this open until full rewrap completes. Triage sev set to P2. Postmortem owners: mira + jon. Thanks all.
